changes: First release: removing a parameter or scene lock with a knob press no longer writes a new lock when the knob slips a detent.
While a TRIG key or SCENE A/B is held, a pressed knob's first detent and every detent for 150 ms after its release are ignored.
Press + turn still makes the coarse x7 edit, starting one detent later.
Known issue: MKII only; tested on one unit.
